title: Thaw
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, isolated log cabin on a snowy mountain during a blizzard, cold blue moonlight against warm firelight, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. Two people drove down the mountain. Three sets of footprints left. 🏔️

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: wet footprints crossed the cabin and ended at Caleb's bed, and Caleb woke up colder than the snow.
scenes.image: a man standing at a frosted cabin window, his reflection pale and still

scenes.narration: The plow driver was an old man named Arne. He took one look at the cabin and didn't get out of his truck.
scenes.image: an old man with a grey beard in the cab of a snowplow truck, headlights on, snow piled high

scenes.narration: He asked Nora one question. Did your dad leave a journal? She nodded. He said: then you know what got in.
scenes.image: old man leaning out of a truck window speaking to a woman in the snow

scenes.narration: Nora packed the car while Caleb waited inside. He kept whistling Dad's song. Caleb never knew that tune.
scenes.image: woman loading bags into a snowy car in front of a cabin, a man's figure in the window

scenes.narration: Before she locked up, she did what Dad would have done. She counted. The footprints in the fresh snow, from the porch to the car.
scenes.image: three distinct trails of footprints in fresh snow leading from a cabin porch to a parked car

scenes.narration: Hers. Small boots. Caleb's. Big boots. And a third set. Long. Narrow. Bare.
scenes.image: close-up of long narrow bare footprints in snow beside two sets of boot prints

scenes.narration: Arne said quietly: thirty-one storms your dad kept it out. It wasn't knocking to get in, girl. It was knocking to get a ride.
scenes.image: old plow driver's weathered face in the cold, eyes full of pity

scenes.narration: Nora looked at the car. Caleb sat in the back, smiling. And beside him, the other seatbelt was buckled. Over nothing.
scenes.image: back seat of a car in snowy light, a seatbelt buckled across an empty seat, frost on the window

scenes.narration: She drove down the mountain anyway. What else could she do? Down there it's warm. It hardly ever snows. And nothing ever has to knock.
scenes.image: car with headlights driving down a winding snowy mountain road toward distant city lights

scenes.narration: Some things you bring home on purpose. Tomorrow: a woman buys twelve Christmas ornaments, and is told to hang only eleven.
scenes.image: an antique box of clear glass Christmas ornaments on red velvet, candlelight
